note: The candidate FindServersRequest encodes a serverUris array with duplicate copies of the same registered server URI, making this size greater than the number of registered server objects.
The duplicate URI strings are carried as request.serverUris and are serialized into the raw OPC UA message.

note: The server decodes the FindServersRequest from the candidate message, preserving the duplicated serverUris entries.
A non-empty filter array enters the filtered FindServers path.
The allocation size is based on the number of registered servers, not the number of matching filter entries; duplicate filters can require more slots than this allocation provides.
The loop iterates once for every filter entry, including duplicate entries.
Each duplicate URI matches the same registered server record created earlier in the candidate sequence.
The pointer array is written once per duplicate match; after the first match it writes beyond the allocation sized for only one registered server.
